purpose: Convert the verified property-question, evidence, legal-authority, procedure, deadline and official-route layers into a neutral human-readable answer without exceeding the established evidence or legal proposition.
language_rules: Use plain language first and legal terminology second where useful.
Separate observed facts from legal propositions and conclusions.
State uncertainty explicitly rather than filling evidence gaps.
Use neutral wording for disputes and contested positions.
Do not imply that a general rule resolves an individual property without property-specific evidence.
Do not present guidance or administrative practice as substantive law.
Do not state a deadline unless its trigger, governing source and counting rule are resolved.
Do not state a remedy or appeal unless the governing framework provides it.

VERIFIED_ANSWER: deadline resolved or explicitly not applicable

hard_stops: Never convert missing evidence into a factual statement.
Never convert a legal possibility into a legal conclusion.
Never conceal an unresolved property or date match.
Never invent a deadline, authority, form, remedy or appeal.
Never present a user-supplied document as an official register record.
Never omit a material exception or condition identified by the authority chain.
Never use a confidence label to compensate for missing evidence.

traceability_contract.every_material_legal_proposition: must link to authoritative legal source
traceability_contract.every_procedure_claim: must link to official procedural source
traceability_contract.every_deadline: must link to governing provision and trigger date
traceability_contract.every_property_specific_conclusion: must link to verified property match
